title.narrative: Meeting between Shahid and IMCC Palestine

description.narrative: Our purpose with this project is to help inform the citizens of Palestine about the risks associated with chronic diseases and how healthy lifestyle choices help relieve the maladies of them. We have after conversations with our partners, Shahid, reached the conclusion that the lack of awareness regarding lifestyle choices and their affect on chronic conditions such as diabetes, is a serious issue, especially for disenfranchised young Palestinians. We therefore sincerely believe this project can inspire sustainable change within marginalised communities that need it. Our vision for this preparatory study is to identify specific diseases that the project can address, leading to the development of a baseline initiative. Additionally, we wish to recruit more volunteers to our core group and want to determine the best ways to ensure that our volunteer group at Shahid possess the necessary skills needed to bring our project to life.
